newsitem.title: USA: Waste Industries Inc IPO prices at $13.50.
newsitem.headline: Waste Industries Inc IPO prices at $13.50.

text.p: Waste Industries Inc said on Friday it completed its initial public offering of 2,150,000 shares of common Stock at $13.50 per share.

The company sold 1,605,200 shares in the offering and certain shareholders sold the remaining 544,800 shares. The company intends to use the net proceeds of the offering to repay short-term indebtedness and for potential future acquisitions, capital expenditures and working capital.
The offering, which had an estimated price range of $10.50 to $12.50 a share, was underwritten by Alex Brown & Sons Inc and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.

Waste Industries was founded in 1970 and is a regional solid waste services company which provides solid waste collection, transfer, recycling, processing and disposal services. The company reported revenues of $92.4 million for 1996, up from $82.3 million the year earlier.
